j4q.shaders

Class Text

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.shaders.Texture
      • j4q.shaders.Text

  • public class Text
extends Texture
    Texture subclass for rendering text onto a bitmap and uploading to OpenGL ES.

    Provides methods for setting text, color, and paint properties, and handles drawing and GPU upload.
